question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the highlighted word.

The __malice__ he developed for all caused a lot of damage.
solution:
The correct answer is **'sympathy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **'malice'.**
 
• **'Malice'** refers to the desire to cause harm or suffering to others. (द्वेष)
 
 
• **Example:** *Despite their long friendship, Ram has **malice** towards Shivam.*
 
 
 
• **'Sympathy'** is a feeling of sincere concern for someone who is experiencing something difficult or painful. (संवेदना)
 
 
• **Example:** *The president has sent a message of **sympathy** to the relatives of the dead soldiers.*
 
 
 
• Hence, **'sympathy'** is the correct antonym of **'malice'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avarice:** It refers to an extreme desire for money. (लोभ)
 
• **Grace:** It is the act of giving acceptance to someone without obligation. (अनुग्रह)
 
• **Oppression:** It is the social act of severely restricting an individual, group, or institution. (उत्पीड़न)
